sloka: उत्तरं द्वारमासाद्य रामः सौमित्रिणा सह ।आवृत्य बलवांस्तस्थौ सुग्रीवश्च हरीश्वरः ।। ६.४२.२७ ।।।।
transliteration: uttaraṁ dvāramāsādya rāmaḥ saumitriṇā saha ।āvṛtya balavāṁstasthau sugrīvaśca harīśvaraḥ ।। 6.42.27 ।।।।

translations.english: Reaching the north gate, Sri Rama along with Saumithri, blockading the gate stood Sugriva the Lord of monkeys.
